stories.title: White House press secretary Leavitt steps down
new_facts: Karoline Leavitt resigns as White House Press Secretary, departing end of month.
stories.line: Trump's White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt is stepping down from the role.

stories.title: Press groups sue Trump over $100,000 early-access scheme for Truth Social posts
new_facts: Federal lawsuit filed over Truth Social paid faster-access service; Trump Media has 10+ customers.
Paid service costs up to $100,000 per month for faster Truth Social data access.
Lawsuit names Trump, two aides as defendants; filed in SDNY; alleges corruption and unconstitutional conduct.
Plaintiffs are The Intercept and Freedom of the Press Foundation; suit filed in Manhattan federal court.
stories.line: Press groups sue Trump over a $100,000-a-month scheme to sell early access to his Truth Social posts.

stories.title: Total solar eclipse sweeps across Europe for first time in 27 years
new_facts: Tens of millions across western Europe witnessing eclipse; UK also a viewing location; Iceland viewing confirmed.
Brian May, age 79, watched eclipse from Spanish observatory and shared it on social media.
On-the-ground witnesses in Mallorca described eclipse as "Absolutely amazing."
stories.line: A total solar eclipse crossed Europe for the first time in 27 years, visible from Spain, Iceland, and the UK.

stories.title: Russell Westbrook retires after 18 NBA seasons
new_facts: Russell Westbrook retires after 18-year NBA career.
Westbrook holds NBA record 209 triple-doubles; 2017 MVP; social media post narrated by Michael B. Jordan.
stories.line: Russell Westbrook retires after 18 seasons in the NBA, ending a Hall of Fame career.

stories.title: Colombia searches rubble after deadly earthquake
new_facts: Colombia declares three days of national mourning after the earthquake.
stories.line: A strong earthquake struck Colombia; rescuers are searching for survivors in rubble as the death toll remains unclear.

stories.title: Wisconsin Democrats nominate centrist over socialist in primary upset
new_facts: Evers called Crowley 'the future of the party' when endorsing him.
Crowley on Wednesday morning signaled Democrats are ready to move on, pushing party unity.
Democrats fear losing if they "talk like aliens" — new on-record framing from Hong's defeat.
Hasan Piker warned on record that 'the knives will be out' for socialists after Hong's loss.
Francesca Hong endorsed David Crowley after her loss, saying campaign was not about one person.
Primary election polls miss by 13 points on average, per G. Elliott Morris analysis.
Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's U.S. Senate Democratic primary last week, cited as progressive context.
stories.line: Wisconsin Democrats nominated a centrist governor candidate over a democratic socialist in a primary that defied polling.

stories.title: Rob Reiner's son indicted in parents' stabbing deaths
new_facts: Nick Reiner, 32, indicted for first-degree murder of parents Rob and Michele Reiner, stabbed in Brentwood home in December.
Prosecutors allege Nick Reiner was lying in wait before attacking his parents.
Nick Reiner pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder with special circumstance allegations.
stories.line: Rob Reiner's son has been indicted on murder charges in the stabbing deaths of his parents at their Los Angeles home.

stories.title: Trump-backed candidates lose string of Republican primaries
new_facts: Larson's loss makes 10 House incumbents defeated in primaries this cycle, an unusually high figure.
Trump's endorsements have flopped in multiple governor races; pattern includes Hassan (MI), Lindell (MN), Ogles (TN).
Minnesota is the first state to set all-female matchups in both its biggest races (Senate and governor).
Andy Ogles (TN) and Amir Hassan (MI) also lost Trump-endorsed primaries; Thomas Smith defeated Hassan in Michigan.
Flanagan faces baggage from a Minnesota fraud scandal that occurred during her tenure as Lt. Gov.
Post-loss, Lindell is questioning the primary vote numbers, echoing his 2020 election denial pattern.
stories.line: Trump-endorsed candidates lost multiple primary races this week, including Mike Lindell in Minnesota's gubernatorial race.

stories.title: DOJ charges former SPLC CFO in alleged $4 million fraud scheme
new_facts: DOJ indicts former SPLC executive for alleged fraud scheme involving payments to extremist informants.
Alleged scheme totaled $4.1 million in donor funds; funds used for KKK robes, cross burnings, and recruitment.
Named individual is Heidi Beirich, charged with conspiracy to commit wire fraud and conspiracy to submit false statements; arrested in California.
stories.line: Federal prosecutors charge a former SPLC financial executive with fraud involving millions of dollars and informant operations.
